threshold_source: Bands 0-13 low/mild, 14-34 moderate, 35-48 high/severe, the score system of Saingam et al. 2014 as applied in R0060 (Malaysia, 2026) and R2129 (Thailand; printed 13-34, read as 14-34); cut-offs 13/14 and 34/35 confirmed in the abstract of Saingam et al. 2014 (completed 2026-11-22, C1)
notes: 16 items scored 0-3. The lowest band includes 0, so it is not a case; moderate+ = dependence at L2-scale; the high band is not L3 (L3 is DSM-5 severe only). Versions (Thai KDS, Malay) coded
